latest_publication.title: How mortgage brokers can automate document collection without weakening the advice file
latest_publication.target_client_type: UK mortgage brokerages and advice firms with repeated document-request, evidence-chasing and case-file administration
latest_publication.industry_or_operating_context: Mortgage broker operations, document collection, evidence tracking, regulated advice-file support and customer chasing
latest_publication.primary_buyer_problem: Mortgage case evidence arrives through several channels and staff repeatedly chase, rename, classify and re-check documents before an adviser can review the case.
latest_publication.primary_search_intent: Understand how to automate mortgage broker document collection and chasing without automating suitability or advice judgement.
latest_publication.trend_or_durable_demand: Durable regulated operational demand. The FCA MCOB rules continue to require records of customer information and the basis of advised mortgage suitability, with relevant advised-sales records retained for at least three years.
latest_publication.evidence_source_and_date: FCA Handbook MCOB 4 advising and selling standards and MCOB Schedule 1 record-keeping requirements, checked 20 August 2026.
latest_publication.existing_article_gap: The site covers generic client onboarding and intake-channel choices, but not mortgage-broker evidence collection, case-file completeness, advice-file traceability or the separation between technical document checks and regulated judgement.

comparison_against_previous_12.why_meaningfully_distinct: This article is specifically about mortgage-broker evidence collection and advice-file support. Its core boundary is between deterministic document logistics and regulated suitability or advice judgement, which the existing onboarding pages do not address.

latest_publication.original_editorial_asset: A five-state mortgage evidence model covering requested, received, incomplete, ready for review and reviewed, with a clear automation action at each state.
latest_publication.first_hand_contribution_or_limits: Uses Henry Oliver's financial-services, data-control and automation background. It does not claim mortgage-advice authorisation and explicitly avoids replacing regulated suitability, affordability or compliance judgement.
latest_publication.proof_points_used_recently: No historic ecommerce proof point was reused as a claim. A fresh illustrative capacity calculation is labelled as an example.
